data.name: Euell
data.gender_notes: Euell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Euell has an Old English origin, derived from the words 'eow' meaning 'horse' and 'hal' meaning 'health' or 'healthy'. The name can be interpreted as 'strong and well'. The name Euell carries the meaning “Strong and well” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Euell usually hope their child will grow to embody strong and well and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Euell belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong and well.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Euell total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Additionally, the name's Old English roots connect the bearer to the rich heritage of Christian tradition and history. In a broader sense, the name Euell can inspire a sense of resilience, determination, and faith in the face of adversity.
